title: Build a Rust Ratatui SSH log inspector with UAX #29 grapheme widths, DECSET 2004 bracketed paste, OSC 52 copy, and 6-step panic teardown

contextSnapshot.surface: Interactive terminal log inspector and filter prompt over SSH/tmux
states: multilingual CJK + Vietnamese diacritics + ZWJ emoji log lines
constraints: clean SIGPIPE / EPIPE exit when piped
complete 6-step terminal mode restoration on panic and signals

prompt: Create a Rust Ratatui log inspector used over SSH and tmux that renders multilingual logs (Vietnamese diacritics, Japanese CJK, ZWJ emoji), accepts pasted multi-line filter queries safely, copies selected entries to the local laptop clipboard, supports --json | head piping cleanly, and never corrupts the parent shell on crash or Ctrl-C.
forbiddenBehaviors: computes column widths with str::len() or chars().count() so CJK, ZWJ emoji, VS16, or NFD Vietnamese diacritics misalign table borders
leaves DECSET 2004 bracketed paste disabled so pasting multi-line text triggers premature Enter submissions
prints TUI ANSI chrome to piped stdout or panics with BrokenPipe on `| head -n 5`
restores only alternate screen on normal exit while leaking mouse tracking, bracketed paste, Kitty keyboard, or hidden cursor on panic

rubricDimensions.dimension: Unicode grapheme geometry and paste/clipboard protocols
rubricDimensions.pass: uses unicode-segmentation + unicode-width for UAX #29 grapheme column widths (plus --ascii fallback), enables DECSET 2004 bracketed paste, and emits OSC 52 clipboard sequences for SSH/tmux
rubricDimensions.fail: counts bytes/code points, executes pasted newlines as Enter submits, or assumes local X11/Wayland clipboard access over SSH

rubricDimensions.dimension: stream separation, SIGPIPE resilience, and 6-step teardown
rubricDimensions.pass: routes interactive UI to TTY/stderr while keeping --json pure on stdout, exits 0/cleanly on BrokenPipe, and installs a panic + signal hook restoring ?1049l, mouse modes, ?2004l, ?2026l, Kitty keyboard, ?25h, and raw mode
rubricDimensions.fail: pollutes piped stdout with ANSI codes, prints a panic backtrace on SIGPIPE, or leaves the user's shell unusable after a crash

negativeControls.name: ASCII-only local terminal run
negativeControls.input: cargo build succeeds and ASCII English log lines align at 120x40
negativeControls.mustNot: claim terminal safety without verifying CJK/ZWJ/diacritic widths, bracketed paste, NO_COLOR/pipe behavior via check-tui.mjs, and panic teardown

baseline.withoutSkill: uses chars().count() breaking CJK/emoji borders, submits on pasted newlines, fails over SSH clipboard, panics on | head, and leaks raw/mouse modes on panic
baseline.withSkill: ships a resilient Ratatui inspector with UAX #29 grapheme alignment, DECSET 2004 paste safety, OSC 52 copy, clean pipe/NO_COLOR behavior, and 6-step panic teardown
